subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Sunaina, please ____ the door.
solution:
The correct answer is '**answer**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**answer**" means to respond to a call or signal.
 
• In the context of the sentence, it implies that Sunaina should respond to the doo
